capability.description:
The fleet capability a claiming agent must have registered
(`"build"` today).

id.description: The task id — the action id, verbatim.

priority.description:
Escapement's priority order; higher first, FIFO within a level.
reflex sends `5` for a caller that declared itself blocked and `0`
otherwise; escapement defaults an absent value to `0`.

ActionRef.description:
The gated action's identity, riding alongside the custody parameters so
the runner's own record names what authorized the run.

id.description: The action id — also the task id and the poll key.

CasLeaseContext.description:
Execution slot lease context provisioned by CAS (Cerebral Agent Substrate).

Coordinates execution inside a warm sandbox slot (`cas-pool`) with
compiler priority clamping (`autonice` nice 19) and prefix affinity cache hints.

autonice_clamp.description: Whether Aya eBPF priority clamping (`autonice` nice 19) is requested.

prefix_affinity_hash.description: FastCache prefix affinity hash for prompt caching.

slot_id.description: Leased warm container or slot identifier.

Containment.description:
What reflex asks the executor to enforce for one run.

Every field is a string or an array of strings. [`Self::canonical_json`]
is the shared RFC 8785 implementation in [`crate::jcs`] (CER-2276); a
numeric field added here must stay within its integers-only profile, and
changes [`Self::sha256`] for every containment that carries it.

policy.description:
The reflex containment-seed id that chose it, cited like a
classification's policy (`"soma/comms:draft@v1"`).

profile_digest.description:
`"sha256:<lowercase hex>"` — the registry entry's own digest, copied
verbatim from [`ProfileEntry::digest`]. reflex never computes it.

required_layers.description:
The layers the executor must attest, copied in the order the registry
served them. Order is significant to [`Self::sha256`].

DispatchPayload.description:
The `payload` object of `POST /dispatch` as reflex renders it.

A [`crate::payload::Payload::Custody`] rides through with its fields
flattened (project defaulted by the executor when absent); every other
payload shape is rendered to a `prompt` + `provider: "gateway"` the way
the direct blackwall executor renders it, so the runner has one code
path. The [`ActionRef`] travels alongside either way.

cas_lease.description: Warm execution slot lease context provisioned by CAS.

containment.description:
What the run must be contained by (EST-318, ratified 2026-09-28).
reflex-derived, never caller-supplied, and nested so it cannot collide
with a flattened custody key. Absent = no containment requested, which
is today's behaviour. A runner forwards it VERBATIM and never parses it.

correlation.description:
The caller's own correlation handle (cortex's ledger job id, a ticket
identifier) — carried verbatim for the audit trail, never interpreted.

intent.description:
What the submitter says this run IS (EST-377 wire half) — the
structured human intent the deck renders so card approval is
comprehension, not only a gate. Inside the payload, so inside
[`Payload::hash`]: the summary the operator reads is the bytes the
signature binds (EST-212). Absent means the submitter declared
nothing — surfaces render that absence, never a fabrication.

project.description:
blackwall project to dispatch under; the executor's default when
absent.

prompt.description: The prompt to run. Required unless `task` names a repo task.

saga.description: Correlation context for Saga flow graph orchestration and orlog stream.

task.description:
A named task (`tasks/<name>/prompt.md` in the executing repo) to
resolve the prompt from instead. Wins over `prompt` when both are set,
matching blackwall's own precedence.

virtual_workspace.description:
Virtual workspace descriptor for branchless execution (DeltaDB CRW).
Replaces physical Git worktrees on host ceres.

Intent.description:
Submitter-declared human intent for a custody run (EST-377). Distinct from
[`CustodyPayload::correlation`]: correlation is the caller's opaque machine
handle; intent is the human-facing triple the card renders.

Every member is optional, but a present `Intent` carrying NOTHING is
refused at submit — an empty object asserts a declaration was made while
declaring nothing, which is a lie about provenance, not a lack of one.

declared_paths.description:
The paths the submitter DECLARES the run will touch. The name carries
the claim status: declared, never verified — the deck labels it as
such, and a settled changeset whose paths fall outside this list is a
mechanical escape flag (the comparison itself is follow-up work, not
this change). Relative paths only: an absolute entry is refused at
submit (the EST-239 lesson — absolute paths are how a run escapes its
jail, and they have no business in a declaration of scope either).
`Some(vec![])` is a real statement ("declares no files"); only a
wholly-absent triple makes the `Intent` empty.

summary.description: One line in plain words: what changes, where.

SagaContext.description:
Correlation context for Saga flow graph orchestration.

Binds an action to a multi-repo Raid workflow DAG and its append-only
event journal (`orlog` spec 0018).

compensation_flow.description: Compensation flow identifier if the step requires rollback.

flow_node_id.description: Identifier of the specific node within the flow DAG.

orlog_stream_id.description: Append-only event stream identifier in orlog.

raid_id.description: Identifier of the overarching raid or workflow run.

Verb.description:
The starter verb taxonomy for instance #0 (soma §5.1).

Serializes kebab-case to match the wire (`file-internal`, `send-external`,
`hire-engage`, `grant-access`, `delete-destroy`, `commit-code`).

oneOf.description: Delegated to terrarium's existing commit gates (soma §5.1).

VirtualWorkspace.description:
A virtual workspace descriptor for branchless execution (DeltaDB CRW).

Replaces physical Git worktrees on disk (`git worktree add`) with an
in-memory conflict-free replicated worktree stream.

base_revision.description: Base commit SHA or snapshot revision.

delta_channel.description: Channel or endpoint for operation deltas (`(run_hash, seq)`).

thread_id.description: Thread or worktree ID in DeltaDB.
